stem: What can the reader conclude about wood frogs from learning that they hop away after thawing out?

options.label: F
options.text: Wood frogs are not truly frozen during winter months.

options.label: G
options.text: Wood frogs have a special process for storing energy.

options.label: H
options.text: Wood frogs have a unique ability to know the temperature.

options.label: J
options.text: Wood frogs are not harmed by the body-freezing process.
